facts.fact: Haweya, an Egyptian company operating under the Central Bank of Egypt's sponsorship, is starting its digital identity verification service with 5 banks, checking the national ID card and a live selfie against civil status data, per its managing director Tamer Gadalla.

systems.owner: Haweya (under Central Bank of Egypt sponsorship)

EGY.note: Civil status data is only the match source for verification; no birth or death link stated.
Says Haweya works under the central bank's sponsorship; no payments mandate, licensing or switch stated.
Nothing on consumer protection rules or redress.
Bank and financial services only; no government e-services stated.
No enrolment count or share stated.
Nothing on who operates or maintains the ID system.
Liveness checks are on Haweya's customers; nothing on the national ID system's enrolment checks or certification.

facts.fact: Haweya's digital identity service lets banks verify a customer remotely by matching the national ID card data and a live selfie against civil status data; the first phase starts with 5 banks, per Haweya's managing director.
Haweya's first phase of operation counts 5 banks relying on it, with all banks in Egypt targeted within 18 months, per its managing director.

EGY.note: No survey share of digital payments stated.
